note: deriveEngineFromWine: a missing, null or non-object wine and a CrossOver wine are Automatic, derived
a Wine whose bin is the current pin wine binary derives pinned:<id>; a proton or a wine-less bin of the same path does not
a pin build the current table no longer ships is Legacy with its own label, never pinned:<retired>
an installed Wine-Staging-macOS release whose bin is its Contents/Resources/wine/bin/wine derives wine-manager:<version>
a release that is not installed, is another type, has no string installDir, or is a DXMT or toolkit build never derives an override
Legacy carries wine.name, or wine.type when the name is empty or missing; a wine with no string bin is Legacy too
with no wine-downloader-info store file the release list is empty: a Wine Manager bin is Legacy
resolveEffectiveEngine: a stored engineOverride string is parsed through the closed grammar; anything outside it is Automatic, still source stored
the legacy key (steamEngineOverride) is read only when engineOverride is not a string; non-strings fall through to derive or Automatic
with derive on, the entry wineVersion wins over the inherited one; the inherited Wine is used only when the entry has none
no stored entry: Automatic derived when derive is off, derived from the inherited Wine when on
readEngineForGame over GamesConfig files: a stored engineOverride wins over every wineVersion, in every non-Steam store
with no engine key the game derives from its own wineVersion, never from the global one when the entry has its own
a game with no wineVersion of its own derives from the global wineVersion (crossover); a game with no file at all does too, and no file is created
a game with no wineVersion of its own derives from the global wineVersion (gptk); a game with no file at all does too, and no file is created
a game with no wineVersion of its own derives from the global wineVersion (current-pin); a game with no file at all does too, and no file is created
a game with no wineVersion of its own derives from the global wineVersion (wine-manager); a game with no file at all does too, and no file is created
no config.json and no game file: Automatic, derived; reading creates nothing
a corrupt file, a null / array / string entry or a document without the app key reads as no entry: the game derives from the global Wine
a bottle-runtime store (Steam) reads engineOverride, then steamEngineOverride, and never derives from wineVersion
readStoredGameConfig refuses an empty, over-long, traversing, separator or NUL name and a non-string; a missing file and a version-only document are undefined
resolveGlobalEngine: a stored engineOverride string is parsed through the grammar and wins over wineVersion
with no stored override the global default derives from wineVersion the same way a game does; a non-string override falls through
engineIdOf prints the override id, or legacy:<label> for display only
the default engine list with CrossOver absent and no pinned engine on disk: CrossOver unavailable, the pin listed uninstalled
CrossOver present and the pinned engine installed: every row installed
a pinned engine with wine but no DXVK is not installed
only installed Wine-Staging-macOS releases appear; DXMT, toolkit, gptk and ungrammatical versions are filtered
a game on Legacy gets a read-only Legacy: <name> row, installed, unavailable, id legacy:<name>
the global default on Legacy shows the same row for { appName: default }
a game with a stored engine key never shows Legacy, whatever its wineVersion
null, non-objects, a Steam game, an unclean appName, an unknown runner and a game with no file get the plain list; { runner, appName: default } is an ordinary app named default
getDefaultEngine for a global config of empty-global: effectiveEngineId, engineSource and legacyLabel
getDefaultEngine for a global config of crossover: effectiveEngineId, engineSource and legacyLabel
getDefaultEngine for a global config of stored-override: effectiveEngineId, engineSource and legacyLabel
getDefaultEngine for a global config of current-pin: effectiveEngineId, engineSource and legacyLabel
getDefaultEngine for a global config of wine-manager: effectiveEngineId, engineSource and legacyLabel
getDefaultEngine for a global config of legacy-gptk: effectiveEngineId, engineSource and legacyLabel
getDefaultEngine for a global config of bogus-override: effectiveEngineId, engineSource and legacyLabel
the per-game bottle name for every non-Steam store; Steam answers null
a name past 64 characters is truncated and suffixed with a 10-hex digest; unusual bytes are percent-style escaped
non-objects, a missing or non-string field, an unknown runner and an unclean appName have no bottle name
parseEngineOverride: the closed grammar; anything else, including every path and every non-string, parses to automatic
isEngineKey accepts a bare Steam appId or runner:appName for a known non-Steam runner; appNameOf returns the part after the first colon
